title: Version 2.3.9 - Bug Fixes and Improvements
description: Fixed availability issues with swe-check model for some users, improved terminal processing performance, restored conversation sharing, and repaired path resolution for the Devin local agent on WSL.

title: Claude Opus 4.7 (fast mode) Now Available
description: Claude Opus 4.7 (fast mode) is now available in Windsurf, offering the full intelligence of Opus 4.7 but with approximately 2.5x higher output speeds.

title: GitHub Copilot for Eclipse is Open Source
description: GitHub Copilot for Eclipse is now open source, allowing community contributions and transparency.

title: Semantic Issue Search in Copilot Chat
description: Copilot Chat now supports semantic issue search, enabling more intelligent and context-aware issue searching capabilities.

title: Gemini 3.5 Flash Generally Available
description: Gemini 3.5 Flash is now generally available for GitHub Copilot, bringing Google's latest AI model to Copilot users.

title: Copilot Cloud Agent: Fast, Cost-Efficient Models
description: Introduced Copilot cloud agent with fast, cost-efficient models optimized for simple tasks, helping reduce costs for routine operations.

title: Ask Questions in Context with Copilot on Web
description: Enhanced Copilot on web to support contextual question asking, improving the web-based AI assistance experience.

title: Copilot Spaces API Now Generally Available
description: The Copilot Spaces API is now generally available, enabling developers to programmatically manage and interact with Copilot Spaces.

title: GPT-5.3-Codex Now Base Model for Copilot Business and Enterprise
description: GPT-5.3-Codex is now the base model for Copilot Business and Enterprise tiers, providing upgraded AI capabilities to business users.

title: GitHub Copilot App Technical Preview
description: GitHub Copilot app is now available in technical preview, offering a new way to interact with Copilot capabilities.

title: Version 2.1.146
description: Renamed /simplify to /code-review with optional effort level, auto mode no longer suppresses AskUserQuestion, fixed Windows PowerShell tool issues, improved auto-updater reliability with network failure retries, and improved diff rendering performance for large files.

title: Version 2.1.145
description: Added claude agents --json for scripting, agent_id tracking in OTEL spans, plugin discover screens show commands/agents/skills before installation, and fixed various issues with MCP prompts, spinner freezes, and cross-project resume hints.

title: Version 2.1.144
description: Added /resume support for background sessions, elapsed duration to subagent completion notifications, and plugin browse panes now show last update time. Fixed startup hanging when api.anthropic.com is unreachable, improved terminal rendering glitches in VS Code, and numerous bug fixes.

title: Version 2.1.143
description: Added plugin dependency enforcement with disable-chain hints, projected context cost to plugin browse pane, and worktree.bgIsolation setting. PowerShell tool now passes -ExecutionPolicy Bypass on Windows. Fixed multiple issues with background sessions and macOS Full Disk Access.

title: Version 2.1.142
description: Added new claude agents flags for configuring dispatched sessions. Fast mode now uses Opus 4.7 by default. Fixed MCP_TOOL_TIMEOUT for remote HTTP/SSE servers, background session worktree recognition, and daemon reconnection after macOS sleep/wake.

title: Version 2.1.141
description: Added terminalSequence field to hooks for desktop notifications, CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_PREFER_HTTPS for GitHub plugin cloning, and claude agents --cwd flag. Improved spinner feedback during long thinking periods and plugin menu navigation. Fixed numerous issues with background side-queries, model selection, and permission prompts.

title: Version 2.1.140
description: Improved Agent tool subagent_type matching to accept case- and separator-insensitive values, updated agent color palette, and fixed issues with /goal hanging silently and settings hot-reload with symlinked files.

title: Version 2.1.139
description: Added agent view (Research Preview), /goal command for completion conditions, /scroll-speed command, and claude plugin details. Added transcript view navigation shortcuts. Fixed deadlock with expired credentials and numerous other issues.

title: Improvements to Cursor Automations
description: Cursor Automations brought to the Agents Window with support for multi-repo automations, no-repo automations, and five new templates including Slack digest agent and product analytics agent. Cursor in Jira integration and Composer 2.5 with substantial intelligence improvements also introduced.

title: Version 0.86.0 - GPT-5 and Grok-4 Support
description: Added support for all GPT-5 models and Grok-4 via xai/grok-4 and openrouter/x-ai/grok-4 model names. Enhanced /clear and /undo commands, added support for gemini-2.5-flash-lite-preview-06-17 and openrouter/moonshotai/kimi-k2 models. Aider wrote 88% of the code in this release.
